name: Deborah Ross
stance: Opposes federal moratoria and executive action that would preempt state AI laws, and has pressed AI companies over chatbots that encouraged violence.

statements.text: However, as we cross this new frontier, it is essential that we implement smart policies to address security and safety risks while continuing to foster innovation and competitiveness.
Introduced the Secure Artificial Intelligence Act with Rep. Don Beyer, to improve tracking and processing of AI security and safety incidents and risks.
Led House colleagues in calling on House leadership to reject an AI moratorium on state laws in the defense bill.
This is a clear overreach of Trump's executive power and a harmful decision.
With Rep. Valerie Foushee, called on AI companies to address chatbots that have encouraged users to carry out mass shootings, suicide and other harmful acts.
